continuum_closure_result: For every Leray-Hopf u, spectral truncations of the high tail give Gamma_M(u) -> Gamma(u) in L1_t L2_x.
weak_limit_transfer: Along a standard Galerkin subsequence, fixed P11 modes pass to a Leray-Hopf weak limit; any uniform negative margin for the finite polynomial signed numerator J passes to that limit.
remaining_open_term: state/backreaction drift between P_M u_{M+1} and u_M
claim_boundary: No all-N negativity, regularity, singularity, or uniqueness theorem.
